reviews.title: Just As Promised!
reviews.comment: I was skeptical about the renewal of the HyperX keyboard since I found out the reviews late after purchasing it. After buying the Refurbished item and reported as Excellent. I could not be anymore relieved how this delivered! I tested it out on Note Pad, HyperX App, Minecraft and SoundCloud EVERYTHING is functional! Sounds are satisfying! The quality experience is fantastic, fast than how my mouse responds. As for the stability there not stutter. Colors are delightful. It actually does look and functions so new, the only unfortunate side is the box for this keyboard didn’t come along. If anyone is still curious, definitely get the REFURBISHED item if it says excellent! BUT, definitely keep high hopes that doesn’t do the opposite. Overall Amazon did learned their lesson.
reviews.author: AccelSpeed

reviews.title: Awesome keyboard
reviews.comment: The media could not be loaded.  https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/D1S9f63JJ7L.mp4 https://m.media-amazon.com/images/I/51VTjQN3fwL._SY256.jpg The keyboard works great and is really nice, even though it was refurbished it works just like it is new. reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.comment: Feels great, love the sound, color, and brightness of the keyboard. It isn't overly obnoxious, but is a nice touch to my setup. I personally enjoy the size and believe this is worth everything I paid for.
reviews.author: Connor Knohl

reviews.title: One of the best OAT
reviews.comment: This is probably my favorite keyboard I've ever owned, but it's not quite a 5 star product for one reason: The cable placement. If instead of on the right side, they placed the detachable cable in the center, or preferably, on the left side, this would be the perfect keyboard. It's light, it has beautiful, customizable RGB, using the NGenuity application. The key presses are not too loud, but loud enough to be satisfying. The responsiveness, and functionality, even without the number pad. Absolutely worth the money.
reviews.author: Noah Pennington
